400.description: Every problem in the request, in one response; `details` maps each field to a list of messages. Covers field rules, fields that are not accepted, `status`, `sub_merchant_status` or `is_active`, and bank fields the SWIFT lookup could not fill. When the only problems are of one kind the code is that kind's: `ERR_MERCHANT_001` with a message naming each field that is not accepted, `ERR_MERCHANT_005` for status fields, `ERR_MERCHANT_019` for bank fields the lookup could not fill, `ERR_MERCHANT_006` for a bank country it could not match. Any other mix is `ERR_MERCHANT_001` with the message `Validation error`.

patch.description: Attach an invoice file to one of your sub-merchants. The request is multipart/form-data. Uploading again replaces the stored invoice.

requestBody.description: multipart/form-data with the document type and the file.

file.description: The invoice file: pdf, jpg, jpeg, png, csv, xlsx or docx, up to 10 MB, with a file name of up to 100 characters. The content must match the extension. A PDF must not be password-protected and must pass EximPe's security check.

document_type.description: Always `INVOICE`. No other document type is accepted.

400.description: `document_type` or `file` is missing, `document_type` is not `INVOICE`, or the file breaks a rule (`ERR_MERCHANT_001`; `details` maps each field to a list of messages).

clientAuth.name: X-Client-ID
clientAuth.description: **Client Application ID** - Your unique application identifier used to authenticate API requests. You can find your Client ID in the Developer Settings section of the merchant dashboard.

clientSecretAuth.name: X-Client-Secret
clientSecretAuth.description: **Client Secret Key** - Your secret key used alongside the Client ID for secure authentication. Keep this confidential and never expose it in client-side code. Available in the Developer Settings section of the merchant dashboard.

apiVersionHeader.name: X-API-Version
apiVersionHeader.description: **API Version** - Specifies which version of the API to use (e.g., '1.X.X', '2.X.X', or '3.X.X'). This header allows you to control which API version your integration uses. Default version information is available in the Developer Settings.

success.description: Indicates if the request was successful. Always false for error responses.

details.description: More about the error. An object keyed by field name when fields fail validation, with nested objects for nested fields; a string when the error is about the request as a whole; or an empty object when there is nothing to add.

success.description: Indicates if the request was successful. Always false for error responses.

code.description: Error code. When the only problems are of one kind it is that kind's code (`ERR_MERCHANT_005`, `ERR_MERCHANT_006`, `ERR_MERCHANT_019`, or `ERR_MERCHANT_001` for fields that are not accepted); any other mix is `ERR_MERCHANT_001`.

message.description: Error message. `Validation error` for a mix of problems; otherwise the message of the one kind of problem, e.g. `global_company.category is not accepted`.

details.description: Every problem found in the request. Each field maps to a list of messages, with nested objects for `global_company` and `settlement_details` and one entry per owner in `beneficial_owners` (`{}` for an owner with no errors). Fields that are not accepted, `status`, `sub_merchant_status` or `is_active`, and bank fields the SWIFT lookup could not fill are listed alongside the other field errors. Rules across fields (the HS code rule, the communication address, the ownership total) are reported once the other fields in their section are valid. An empty object when there is nothing to add.

v3_CreateMerchantRequest.description: Send only the fields listed here. Any other field, at the top level or inside `global_company`, `settlement_details` or a beneficial owner, is refused with a 400 naming the field.

phone_number.description: Contact phone number in E.164 format, e.g. `+919876543210`.

beneficial_owners.description: Optional. Accepted only when your account collects under EximPe's own PA-CB licence; checked against the owner rules when sent. Otherwise leave it out or send an empty list.

bank_swift_code.description: SWIFT/BIC code. 8 or 11 characters, upper case: 6 letters, then 2 letters or digits, then an optional 3-character branch code of letters or digits. Bank fields you leave out are filled from this code; values you send are kept.

bank_name.description: Name of the bank. Optional: when left out, filled from `bank_swift_code`.

bank_branch_name.description: Branch name. Optional: when left out, filled from `bank_swift_code`.

bank_address.description: Branch address. Optional: when left out, filled from `bank_swift_code`.

bank_city.description: Branch city. Optional: when left out, filled from `bank_swift_code`.

bank_country.description: Branch country. A country name from Get Merchant Options, e.g. `India`. Matched case-insensitively; returned in the listed spelling. Optional: when left out, filled from `bank_swift_code`.

bank_pincode.description: Branch postal code. Optional: when left out, filled from `bank_swift_code`.

routing_number.description: Routing number, sort code or IFSC. Optional.

website.description: Company website. Must start with `https://` (`http://` is refused) and include a domain, e.g. `https://example.com`.

monthly_avg_transaction_volume.description: Expected monthly transaction volume, in US dollars.

business_category.description: One or more category slugs from your approved categories, comma-separated, e.g. `GOODS,SOFTWARE_CONSULTING`. Matched case-insensitively; returned in upper case. See Get Merchant Options.

hs_codes.description: HS codes for the goods traded. Required when a goods category is selected; refused otherwise. Find codes with Search HS Codes. `null` or an empty list when there are none.

mcc.description: Merchant Category Codes, comma-separated 4-digit codes, e.g. `5411,5812`.

agreement_details.description: The agreement you hold with the sub-merchant.

registered_country.description: Registered office country, and the sub-merchant's country. A country name from Get Merchant Options, e.g. `India`. Matched case-insensitively; returned in the listed spelling.

same_as_registered_address.description: Whether the communication address is the registered address. When `true`, the registered address is copied into the communication fields and any communication values you send are replaced. When `false`, every communication field is required.

communication_state.description: Communication state or province. Required when `same_as_registered_address` is `false`.

communication_country.description: Communication country. A country name from Get Merchant Options, e.g. `India`. Matched case-insensitively; returned in the listed spelling. Required when `same_as_registered_address` is `false`.

communication_pincode.description: Communication postal code. Required when `same_as_registered_address` is `false`.
